title: Euro 2012: Player-by-Player Guide to Germany's Squad
content: # Euro 2012: Player-by-Player Guide to Germany's Squad. After winning 10 matches out of 10 in qualification, Germany will attempt to turn their 100 percent winning qualification record into finals points—a feat that isn't so easy when you've been handed a place in the Group of Death alongside Portugal, Netherlands and Denmark. 26-year-old goalkeeper Manuel Neuer is considered to be one of the best goalkeepers in the world at present, and as he matures he is surely only going to improve. Bayern Munich central defender Holger Badstuber has risen to prominence under the management of Germany national team coach Joachim Low. The 23-year-old was selected more than any other German defender in the qualification matches for Euro 2012, suggesting that he is a first choice when it comes to Germany's starting XI. Lahm is considered to be one of the best full backs that has ever played the game and has notched 84 caps for the German national side to date.

title: Euro 2012: Germany's Joachim Löw names his 23-man ...
content: Germany' Holger Badstuber, left, Toni Kroos and Thomas Müller enjoy a time-out at their Euro 2012 training camp in Tourrettes, SE France. # Euro 2012: Germany's Joachim Löw names his 23-man squad. Cacau, Marc-Andre ter Stegen, Sven Bender and Julian Draxler have all been left out of Joachim Löw's 23-man selection for Euro 2012. The head coach, who took a 27-man squad into training camps in Sardinia and France, will explain his choices on Tuesday, when he will be working with his final group in the build-up to their first match of the tournament, against Portugal on 9 June. "It was my big goal after the World Cup in South Africa [in 2010] also to be part of Euro 2012 with the Germany national team," Cacau said. Like the younger players, I am also disappointed, but I still feel part of this team and wish them from the bottom of my heart that they play a great European Championship.".
